tags.name: gc-toggle-switch
tags.description: An on/off switch, horizontal or vertical, usable with a pointer (click or drag) and the keyboard (Space, Enter).

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: The "on" state (reflected). Also sets the default state used by form.reset().

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the switch and excludes it from the form.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid while the switch is off.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted when the switch is on.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner, exposes aria-busy and ignores user actions.

attributes.name: off-color
attributes.description: Track colour when off (any CSS colour). Wins over --switch-off-color.

attributes.name: on-color
attributes.description: Track colour when on (any CSS colour). Wins over --switch-on-color.

attributes.name: state-labels
attributes.description: Shows I / O state indicators in the track.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Orientation. Wins over --switch-vertical; horizontal when neither is set.
